newsitem.title: USA: US corporate bonds spreads end flat, look to data.
newsitem.headline: US corporate bonds spreads end flat, look to data.

text.p: U.S. corporate bonds weathered mild weakness in U.S. Treasuries and closed with spreads unchanged as players peered ahead to new issuance and economic data, dealers said.
High-yield bonds were also firm on the heels of strong price action last week, meanwhile, and were quoted mostly unchanged into the market close.
Some investment grade issuers, including ConAgra Inc and Bankers Trust New York, tapped the market on Monday in an effort to capitalize on U.S. Treasury yields well-through the seven percent level.
